events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Collier (UTA) loses control of the ball and is the last player to touch it before it goes out of bounds.
Grimes (PHI) extends his arm to the side as he spins away from Collier (UTA) and the ensuing contact is marginal.
Collier (UTA) legally contests Grimes' (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Bona (PHI) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Edwards (PHI) initiates illegal contact with George's (UTA) arm during his jump shot attempt.
Bona (PHI) places both hands on George's (UTA) body as they come together during the pick and the contact is marginal.
Martin (UTA) legally contests Edwards' (PHI) jump shot attempt.
Grimes (PHI) and Filipowski (UTA) come together in the air pursuing the rebound and the contact is incidental. Filipowski then loses his balance on his own accord as he returns to the floor.
Filipowski (UTA) receives the pass while planting his left foot and he takes one step and legally comes to a jump stop before releasing his jump shot attempt.
Bona (PHI) legally contests Filipowski's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Martin (UTA) cleanly blocks Bona's (PHI) dunk attempt and any ensuing contact is incidental.
Edwards (PHI) moves laterally into George (UTA), initiating body contact that affects his SQBR before he gathers the ball and enters his shooting motion.
Bona (PHI) legally contests George's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Grimes (PHI) avoids making any illegal contact with Martin (UTA) during Martin's layup attempt at the basket.
Martin (UTA) commits a take foul on Edwards (PHI). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Bona (PHI) legally contests Filipowski's (UTA) jump shot attempt.
Juzang (UTA) commits a take foul on Grimes (PHI).
Grimes (PHI) legally contests Filipowski's (UTA) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Collier (UTA) briefly has his arm around Grimes (PHI) but removes it and allows him to move freely.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Edwards (PHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. George (UTA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and possession is given to Philadelphia when play resumes.
Collier (UTA) wraps his arm around Walker IV (PHI), making illegal contact that affects his FOM.
